  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3564018931",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "delegating template eviction responsibility to the client can cause out of memory crashes if handled poorly",
      "quote": "Delegating template eviction responsibility to the client can put us in a situation where they handle it poorly and cause us to OOM",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained client responsibility is inherent to multiprocess and FIFO eviction can be used as a fallback if needed",
      "author_replies": ["c:3570105870"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3570105870",
      "status_by_quote": "In the scenario where they handle it poorly, we can use FIFO deletion. All `getMemoryLoad()` does is give clients an opp"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3493499544",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use internal memory management with a memory budget and FIFO template release rather than relying on IPC clients",
      "quote": "In my opinion, we should not rely on the IPC client to manage our memory.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained internal memory management treats IPC clients no differently than internal code, and FIFO eviction can be a last resort",
      "author_replies": ["c:3563799563"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3563799563",
      "status_by_quote": "It seems counter intuitive, but from a memory management perspective IPC clients are treated no different than our own c"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2581145624",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add test coverage for the unkilled mutant in template_tx_refs reference counting",
      "quote": "Just ran a mutation testing for this PR and this is the only unkilled mutant - feel free to ignore if it doesn't make sense to address",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author adjusted interface_ipc.py test to cover the mutant, which reviewer confirmed",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2584340016"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2587699846",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice, thank you!"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2590041765",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "template_tx_refs map accessed across multiple threads without synchronization creates data race hazards",
      "quote": "This map can updated from multiple threads, so it needs a mutex to be used safely.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added template_state_mutex",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2592303231"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2592303231",
      "status_by_quote": "To limit the scope of this PR, I only added the mutex, but called it `template_state_mutex` in anticipation."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2590089590",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "ask if there was a particular reason to assert that the bench log message is logged",
      "quote": "Seems ok to assert this log message is logged, but I'm wondering if there was a particular reason for doing this.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained it checks that bench logging happens",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2591987168"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2591987168",
      "status_by_quote": "This just checks that bench logging happens."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2878931110",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use std::unordered_map instead of std::map since ordered entries are not needed",
      "quote": "std::map has lookup `O(log(size))` whereas `std::unordered_map` has `O(1)`. Here we do not need the entries to be ordered.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched TxTemplateMap to std::unordered_map",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2891914696"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2891914696",
      "status_by_quote": "Done both."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2894597519",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "use custom salted hasher and comparator for CTransactionRef in TxTemplateMap rather than comparing pointers",
      "quote": "it is the same for `map` and `unordered_map` when used with `shared_ptr` (or `CTransactionRef`) - they compare pointers.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted CTransactionRefSaltedHash and CTransactionRefComp",
      "author_replies": ["c:4205258678", "rc:3050397606"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:4081459739",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 10acf818ed70d4cd2af864278a35a6b64de0bb16"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3093561704",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "whether std::hash<CTransactionRef> parameter type should be CTransactionRef instead of const CTransactionRef&",
      "quote": "Should this be `CTransactionRef` instead of `const CTransactionRef&`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "maflcko confirmed the docs refer to the logical type; the commit was later moved to #35101",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3100650418"],
      "other_replies": ["rc:3101810363"],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3101810363",
      "status_by_quote": "No, I am sure the docs just refer to the logical type"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3100806462",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "IWYU workaround in primitives/transaction.h is wrong and harmful",
      "quote": "NACK This is wrong and harmful, as already explained in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35073#issuecomment-4258599969",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "IWYU workaround and CTransactionRef hasher commit moved to #35101 and dropped from this PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4270824311",
        "rc:3100822626",
        "rc:3101139032",
        "rc:3101448908",
        "rc:3101665167",
        "rc:3102893023"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4270824311",
      "status_by_quote": "The safety commit for `CTransactionRef` and IWYU changes are now in #35101 and dropped from this PR."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5835060997",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "drop commit 596cb52b814e5e443f4f015cd5aac91915cff057",
